hints.systemTags: Assigned automatically from account status (e.g. verified email, repeat orders). These cannot be edited.
hints.id: Permanent identifier for this customer. Used in the admin and APIs; it cannot be changed.
hints.name: Display name from the customer account. Managed by the customer during registration or profile updates.
hints.email: Primary email address linked to the account. Cannot be edited here.
hints.phone: Optional contact phone number shown in the admin customer profile.
hints.address1: Street name and building number for the default address.
hints.address2: Optional apartment, suite, or additional address line.
hints.city: City or locality for the default address.
hints.postalCode: Postal or ZIP code for the default address.
hints.countryCode: Two-letter ISO country code, for example PL or DE.
hints.notes: Private notes for your team. Never shown to the customer on the storefront.
hints.customTags: Add your own labels to segment or flag customers. Type a tag and click Add tag or press Enter.

toast.errorDescription: Please check the form and try again.

emailChange.title: Change email address
emailChange.description: Send {name} a link to confirm a new sign-in address, when the current mailbox can no longer be reached or the address has a typo.
emailChange.sent: Link sent to {email}. The address changes once the customer opens it.

verify.title: Check it is the customer
verify.description: Ask the customer for the number of an order placed while signed in to this account and the postal code it was delivered to. Never read them out from the order list.
verify.orderNumberHint: As the customer reads it from the order confirmation. Letter case, spaces and dashes do not matter.
verify.postalCodeHint: The postal code of the delivery address on that same order. Letter case, spaces and dashes do not matter, and it is never stored.

address.title: New address
address.description: The account keeps its current address until the new one is confirmed.
address.newEmailHint: The link goes to this address. It cannot belong to another account.

rules.title: How the change works
rules.description: The rules the shop applies to every change of a customer's address.
rules.link: The address changes only when the link sent to the new address is opened. The link expires after 60 minutes.
rules.notice: Once the address changes, every other device signed in to the account is signed out, and the shop tells the previous address about it.
rules.signedIn: Only an order placed while signed in to this account counts, because anyone can place an order with someone else's email address.
rules.attempts: After {max} attempts within an hour, the account cannot be checked again until the hour has passed.
rules.audit: Every attempt is recorded in the audit log, with who made it and the order number used, but never the postal code.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.required: The admin panel opens only once two-factor authentication is on. Turn it on below with an authenticator app; from then on, signing in with your password also asks for a six-digit code.
security.requiredWithoutPassword: The admin panel opens only once two-factor authentication is on, and turning it on needs a password. This account signs in with Google and has no password yet, so set one below first, then turn on two-factor authentication.
security.optional: Two-factor authentication is optional in this environment, so the admin panel is already open. In production, the admin panel opens only once it is on.
security.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Signing in with your password also asks for a code from your authenticator app.

cancelBlocked.openDispute: This order has an open dispute. Cancelling would refund its payment, which the dispute now decides, so the order cannot be cancelled until the dispute closes.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel order?
cancelDialog.description: Order {id} will be cancelled and its items returned to stock. There is no payment to refund. The customer is emailed about the cancellation. This action cannot be undone.
cancelDialog.refundDescription: Order {id} will be cancelled, its items returned to stock and the customer's payment refunded in full through Stripe. The customer is emailed about the cancellation and the refund. This action cannot be undone.

toast.emailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the “{email}” email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, resend it from the order's Activity card, which also shows the error.
toast.emailAlreadySentDescription: The order already reached this step before, so the “{email}” email was not sent again.
toast.trackingEmailSentDescription: The order was already marked as shipped before, so the customer received only a short message with the current tracking number.
toast.cancelSuccessDescription: Order cancelled and its items returned to stock. A paid order shows the refund once Stripe confirms it.
toast.cancelEmailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the cancellation email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, resend it from the order's Activity card, which also shows the error.
toast.errorDescription: Please try again in a moment.
toast.invalidStateDescription: This action is not available for the order's current state.
toast.openDisputeDescription: This order has an open dispute, which decides what happens to its payment. Until the dispute closes, the payment cannot be refunded and the order cannot be cancelled.
toast.stepBackSuccessDescription: The order is back at the previous step.
toast.refundSuccessDescription: Refund submitted to Stripe. The order updates once Stripe confirms it.
toast.restockSuccessDescription: The order's items are back in stock.
toast.resendEmailSentDescription: Resend took the email. The order's Activity card records it.
toast.resendEmailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, the order's Activity card offers Resend email again.

timeline.title: Activity

customer.emailsGoTo: The account no longer uses the address this order was placed with, so emails about the order go to {email}.

shipping.title: Shipping Address
shipping.lockerAddressMissing: This order did not keep the locker's address. Look it up by its code in InPost's parcel manager.
shipping.recipientHint: InPost texts the pickup code to this number. This is not the delivery address.
shipping.lockerUnconfirmed: InPost could not be reached to confirm this parcel locker when the order was placed. Check that it exists before you send the parcel.

inpost.title: InPost shipment
inpost.createHint: Book this parcel with InPost to get its label and tracking number here.
inpost.notAvailable: A shipment can be created while the order is open and not yet shipped.
inpost.notConfigured: Automatic InPost shipping is not connected, so the label and the shipment status do not appear here. Create the parcel in InPost Manager as usual, then mark the order shipped and paste its tracking number. The customer gets an email with the tracking link.
inpost.label: Download label

createDialog.title: Create an InPost shipment
createDialog.lockerDescription: InPost delivers the parcel to the locker the customer chose. Choose the locker size it fits.
createDialog.courierDescription: InPost's courier delivers the parcel to the shipping address. Choose its size and enter its weight.

toast.createdDescription: InPost confirms it within a few moments. Refresh its status to get the tracking number and the label.

errors.credentialsRejected: InPost did not accept the shop's access details, so the parcel cannot be created from here. Create it in InPost Manager and paste its tracking number when you mark the order shipped.
errors.notConfigured: Automatic InPost shipping is not connected. Create the parcel in InPost Manager and paste its tracking number when you mark the order shipped.
errors.unavailable: InPost did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.shipmentRefused: InPost refused the shipment. Check the customer's phone number and address, and the parcel size and weight.
errors.shipmentMissing: InPost could not find this shipment.
errors.labelNotReady: InPost has no label for this shipment yet. Refresh its status: the label is ready once InPost confirms the shipment.
errors.invalidState: This action is not available for the order's current state.
errors.failed: Please try again in a moment.

paymentDetails.title: Payment
paymentDetails.missing: No payment recorded for this order.

notes.title: Customer Note
notes.empty: The customer did not leave a note.

shipDialog.title: Mark order as shipped
shipDialog.description: Add the tracking details the customer will see in their account and shipping email. Both fields are optional. Left blank, they keep the tracking number the order already has from its InPost shipment.

trackingDialog.title: Save the tracking number?
trackingDialog.description: The order is already marked as shipped. The number and link you enter replace the saved tracking details, and the customer sees them in their account. The shipping date stays as it is.
trackingDialog.emailNote: The customer receives the “{email}” email with this number, unless it is the number already saved.

delivered.title: Mark the order as delivered?
delivered.description: Order {id} moves to “Delivered” and is completed.

customerEmail.alreadySent: The order already reached this step before, so the “{email}” email is not sent again.
customerEmail.trackingUpdate: If you enter a new tracking number, the customer receives only a short message with that number.

stepBack.title: Move the order back a step?
stepBack.description: Order {id} goes back from “{from}” to “{to}”. The customer is not emailed about it.
stepBack.emailNote: Moving the order forward again later sends no second email for a step the order has already been through.
stepBack.inpostWarning: The InPost shipment is not cancelled, and its tracking number stays on the order. If the parcel will not be sent, cancel the shipment in InPost Manager.

refundDialog.title: Refund this order?
refundDialog.description: This issues a full refund for order {id} through Stripe. The customer is emailed about it once Stripe confirms the refund.
refundDialog.restockLabel: The items came back to stock
refundDialog.restockHint: Tick this only when the goods are back in the shop, so they go on sale again. Leave it clear for a lost parcel or a goodwill refund; you can return them to stock from this order later.

restockDialog.title: Return the items to stock?
restockDialog.description: The items of order {id} go back on sale. Do this only once the goods are back in the shop. An order's items return to stock only once.

refundBlocked.noStripePayment: Nothing to refund: this order was free, so Stripe took no payment for it.
refundBlocked.openDispute: This order has an open dispute. The dispute decides what happens to the payment, so it cannot be refunded until the dispute closes.

cancelBlocked.openDispute: This order has an open dispute. Cancelling would refund its payment, which the dispute now decides, so the order cannot be cancelled until the dispute closes.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this order?
cancelDialog.description: Order {id} will be cancelled and its items returned to stock. There is no payment to refund. The customer is emailed about the cancellation. This cannot be undone.
cancelDialog.refundDescription: Order {id} will be cancelled, its items returned to stock and the customer's payment refunded in full through Stripe. The customer is emailed about the cancellation and the refund. This cannot be undone.

unsubscribeDialog.errorTitle: The address could not be unsubscribed

This cannot be undone. A customer account with this address, and its own entries, stay as they are.
